## Inventory (backend-pillars)

Verified by reading headers under `include/atomiverse/` on `dev`. Contents of
`internal/` subdirectories are excluded from the public surface (their
existence is noted).

### Module list

**Contract layer**
- `include/atomiverse/core` — 23 headers, no subdirectories
- `include/atomiverse/molrs.hpp` + molrs bridge points (`core/molrs_contract.h`, `cpu/frame/molrs_exchange.h`, `cuda/frame/molrs_exchange.cuh`, `torch/frame/molrs_exchange.cuh`, `cpu/io/frame_writer.h`, `cpu/observe/trajectory_metrics.h`)

**CPU backend** (`include/atomiverse/cpu/`, 30 directories, no loose files at root)
- `frame` (8) · `driver` (8) · `component` (27) · `evaluate` (2)
- `device` (2) · `communication` (11) · `neighbor` (3) · `asynchronous` (6) · `linalg` (5, CPU-only) · `replica` (2, CPU-only) · `io` (5, CPU-only) · `task` (5, CPU-only)
- `dynamics` (35) · `minimize` (15) · `montecarlo` (9, CPU-only) · `path` (9, CPU-only) · `potentials` (39 + `eam_data/`, `sw_data/`) · `longrange` (13) · `observe` (22) · `record` (6)
- `scf` (132 total: 73 public + 59 under `internal/`, plus `stages/`, `basis_data/`) · `semiempirical` (30: 22 public + `internal/`, `basis_data/`; CPU-only) · `planewave` (27: 7 public + `internal/`) · `gpw` (42: 13 public + `internal/`, `basis_data/`; CPU-only) · `xc` (1) · `electronic` (7, CPU-only) · `vibration` (19, CPU-only)
- `bias` (7, CPU-only) · `multiscale` (9: 6 public + `internal/`; CPU-only) · `electrodes` (2, CPU-only)

**CUDA backend** (`include/atomiverse/cuda/`, 17 directories)
- `frame` (5) · `driver` (4) · `component` (10) · `evaluate` (2)
- `device` (6) · `communication` (2) · `neighbor` (1) · `asynchronous` (3)
- `dynamics` (10) · `minimize` (5) · `potentials` (12) · `longrange` (3) · `observe` (3) · `record` (3)
- `scf` (12: 4 public + `internal/`) · `planewave` (7: 1 public + `internal/`) · `gpw` (4: 0 public, all `internal/` — kernel footholds only: Poisson FFT, Padé LDA XC, ρ collocate, V·shape integrate; no method product)

CPU-only domains, absent (never renamed) on `cuda/`: `bias`, `electrodes`, `electronic`, `io`, `linalg`, `montecarlo`, `multiscale`, `path`, `replica`, `semiempirical`, `task`, `vibration`, `xc`. `gpw` is no longer absent — `cuda/gpw/internal/` carries unit-tested kernel footholds, but the GPW method product remains CPU-only (`cuda-gpw-full-product` stays blocked).

**Torch backend** (`include/atomiverse/torch/`, 5 directories, 8 headers) — `frame`, `component`, `device`, `neighbor`, `potentials`. Partial backend: no driver/, no evaluate/.

`src/` mirrors `core/`, `cpu/`, `cuda/`, `torch/` 1:1.

`scf/internal/` holds `SCFSolver` + `SolverContext` · `pw::PW{upf_path, ecut_ry, k_mesh, tol, max_iter, mix_beta, pulay_depth, xc, spin_polarized, multiplicity, smearing, degauss, mp_order, extra_bands}` with `build(const cpu::Frame&)` / `run(const cpu::Frame&) -> PWResult&` / `last_result()`, sharing `cpu::pw::PWResult`/`Smearing`; device envelope = `XCType::LSDA` + restricted + fixed occupations + no MPI k-distribution, everything else throws `std::invalid_argument` with a how-to; `planewave/internal/` holds `DeviceBandSolver` (band side; borrows both real-space grids via `bind_grids`) and `DeviceDensity` (density side: `hartree`/`exchange_correlation`/`assemble_veff`/`zero_accumulator`/`collect`/`mix`/`reduce`, owning ρ(G)/V_H/V_xc/V_loc/V_eff, the Pulay ring and the fused reductions) over the `fft`/`poisson`/`grid_map`/`veff`/`xc_lda` device launchers. Per SCF iteration nothing O(N_G)/O(N_r) crosses PCIe — only the ≤8×8 Pulay Gram, its coefficients and 5 energy/residual doubles; the Pulay coefficient solve is the shared host `cpu::pw::internal::solve_pulay_coefficients`.

**torch** — `torch::Frame` (`at::Tensor` blocks), `Context`, `StreamGuard`, `NeighborList` + `neighbor_list(frame, cutoff, skin)`, `lj(...)`, `harmonic_bond(...)`, `to_torch`/`to_cuda`/`to_cpu`/`from_cpu`/`destroy`, `from_molrs`/`to_molrs`.

### Style summary

- **Project-wide**: naming = `PascalCase` types, `snake_case` methods/files, LAMMPS-canonical component names (`PairLJCut`, `BondHarmonic`, `Fix*`), `k`-prefixed constexpr keys (`kAtom_x`, `kEnergy`, `kAtomQmZ`); construction = direct constructors with ordered args and/or public members set before `build()`/`run()`; **no public `*Config` bags** (only `core/log.h` `LogConfig`, `AnalysisExecutor::Config`, and `internal/` `NDDOConfig` exist, all infra/private); **no public factory free functions** except the pinned exceptions `ATV::make_binding` (constexpr enum→slot pair) and `cpu::comm::make_*_plan` (comm pack plans); errors = `throw std::invalid_argument` / `std::runtime_error` with how-to messages, no fallback values; Frame access = `frame.span(ColKey<T>)` for columns, `frame.meta.get(MetaKey<T>)` for scalars; units eV/Å/fs/amu/K on the public surface, Hartree/Ry internal to `scf`/`planewave`/`gpw`/`semiempirical`.
- **core**: header-per-contract; aggregates + `constexpr` keys/traits; errors are compile-time (`static_assert`, template specialization) plus `molrs::validate` throw.
- **cpu/frame**: `Frame(n)`, `Box::cubic/orthorhombic`; typed `column_error`, `meta_error`, `stale_handle_error`.
- **cpu/driver + cpu/component**: preset default ctors install defaults; ownership: `on(phase).add(rvalue)` / `set_xxx(rvalue)` transfer, `add_ref` / `set_xxx_ref` borrow, plain `add(lvalue)` and `set_xxx(lvalue)` `= delete`; throw at registration and in `validate_components()`.
- **cpu/scf, semiempirical, planewave, gpw**: method acronyms (`RHF`, `DFTB2`, `PW`, `GpwDft`), `*Result` value structs; parameters as public members plus ctor overloads; lookup ctors `GthPotential(Element, name)`; throw on unsupported element/basis/ECP; `internal/` namespaces for workspace.
- **cpu/dynamics, potentials, longrange, minimize, montecarlo, path, observe, record**: LAMMPS-style names; all-positional ctor args (`PairLJCut{eps, sigma, cutoff}`, `VelocityVerlet{dt}`, `MC{T_K, seed}`, `LBFGS{m, alpha0, max_ls}`); categorical setters; throw in `build()` on missing neighbor list / unmatched long-range pair.
- **cpu/communication, device, asynchronous, neighbor, replica, task, io, linalg, xc**: infra nouns (`DomainRuntime`, `DeviceRuntime`, `AnalysisRuntime`); engine-side, Runtime-owned; MPI-lockstep status folding in `task/`, throw elsewhere.
- **cuda/**: mirrors CPU one-for-one; same ctor-arg shape; `.cuh`/`.cu` except deliberately CUDA-free `device/log_callback.h`, `device/timer.h`, `potentials/pair_kernel.h`; `error.cuh` check macros + host-side throws; `cuda::scf::RHF` takes `cpu::Frame&` at its boundary.
- **torch/**: lowercase free functions for operators (`lj`, `harmonic_bond`, `neighbor_list`) — the one backend where free-function operator style is the convention; tensor-in/tensor-out.

### Layer roles

- `core` — CUDA-free contract layer (shared by all three backends)
- molrs bridge — external-exchange boundary (FFI); one conversion point per boundary
- `cpu/frame`, `cuda/frame`, `torch/frame` — **Frame pillar**
- `cpu/driver`, `cuda/driver` — **Driver pillar** (loop node, Runtime, criteria, OutcomePolicy)
- `cpu/component`, `cuda/component`, `torch/component` — **Component pillar** (base, kinds, Context slices, opt-in protocols)
- `cpu/evaluate`, `cuda/evaluate` — Evaluate preset + `single_point` (Driver-pillar preset)
- `cpu/device`, `cuda/device`, `torch/device` — infra cluster (DeviceRuntime / streams / timing)
- `cpu/communication`, `cuda/communication` — infra cluster (domain decomposition, halo, migration, reductions)
- `cpu/neighbor`, `cuda/neighbor`, `torch/neighbor` — infra cluster (cell/Verlet + published PairList)
- `cpu/asynchronous`, `cuda/asynchronous` — infra cluster (AnalysisRuntime, snapshot ring, D2H bridge)
- `cpu/linalg` — infra cluster, CPU-only (shared dense LA)
- `cpu/replica` — infra cluster, CPU-only (ReplicaSet / ReplicaExpansion)
- `cpu/electronic` — infra cluster, CPU-only (shared electronic-state propagators)
- `cpu/io` — infra/boundary cluster, CPU-only (external formats + molrs writers)
- `cpu/task` — infra cluster, CPU-only (MPI launcher task protocol)
- `cpu/dynamics`, `cuda/dynamics` — method domain (MD)
- `cpu/minimize`, `cuda/minimize` — method domain (optimizers + opt recorders)
- `cpu/montecarlo` — method domain, CPU-only
- `cpu/path` — method domain, CPU-only (coupled replicas)
- `cpu/scf`, `cuda/scf` — method domain (Gaussian-basis SCF; CPU node is a Driver, CUDA is `RHF` + `internal::SCFSolver`)
- `cpu/semiempirical` — method domain, CPU-only (NDDO/AM1/RM1/DFTB/xTB)
- `cpu/planewave`, `cuda/planewave` — method domain (plane-wave DFT)
- `cpu/gpw` — method domain, CPU-only
- `cpu/xc` — method domain, shared XC pieces
- `cpu/vibration` — method domain, CPU-only (FD Hessian, phonons, thermochemistry)
- `cpu/longrange`, `cuda/longrange` — method domain (reciprocal-space electrostatics + its own operator math)
- `cpu/potentials`, `cuda/potentials`, `torch/potentials` — method domain (real-space pair + bonded evaluators)
- `cpu/bias` — method domain, CPU-only (CVs, harmonic bias, metadynamics)
- `cpu/multiscale` — method domain, CPU-only (QM/MM connection-layer evaluators)
- `cpu/electrodes` — method domain, CPU-only (electrode charge dynamics/work)
- `cpu/observe`, `cuda/observe` — observe (derived quantities, Observer kind)
